subject.title: fix(web-fetch): forward NO_PROXY to EnvHttpProxyAgent options so env proxy respects bypass entries

question: Should this branch be repurposed as narrow EnvHttpProxyAgent option hardening, or should it pause behind the canonical NO_PROXY/SSRF policy decision for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93807?
rationale: The code change is not the complete web_fetch fix, and the remaining desired behavior changes operator proxy and SSRF-boundary semantics that automation should not choose.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open or paused until maintainers choose the canonical NO_PROXY behavior and decide whether this partial option-forwarding change is still useful.

options.title: Narrow And Prove Hardening
options.body: Remove the closing claim, add option-forwarding tests, and require real proxy proof before considering it as a small hardening PR.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Canonical Work
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the real fix must live only in the guarded-fetch policy path or a replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Pause For Canonical Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open or paused until maintainers choose the canonical NO_PROXY behavior and decide whether this partial option-forwarding change is still useful.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest history on the trusted env-proxy web_fetch opt-in and guarded-fetch/proxy-env boundary.
